# PR #478 corrected native QA at ca9ac7bd

**The five targeted correction cases passed. A separate Reset double-click check reproduced unintended connection removal.** The broader preservation matrix remains pending because the runner stopped on that product outcome. Zero fixture correction batches were used. This evidence consumes zero additional formal review scans.

## Frozen source and build

- Candidate `ca9ac7bdea9adb0a05a5e515fb6d7bb229b1eab8`, tree `16cfc0dd206cf4a4865281c296eb26f289f0f252`, corrections parent `47b00a520a4b8787786102cac69d84f145f2ed1c`, actual main and target `41bde22c80a796bf8c4bec8ab5dec8e755271f9e`. The original canvas checkout and index stayed clean. The separately tested model-level and stale action-time cases are from the implementation handoff, outside the native set. [Actual-main integration](../review-correction-main-integration.json) · [Execution admission](execution-admission.json)
- The literal admission SHA-256 is `31e5c66f703859b4591fa8e11f4b5a96e56af940b676fafc73a75fdb705bd878`; the sealed 12-file preparation manifest is `1c1b4fd2297833feabe2e80b0f6e4abbb9147021ea3ed3117405dd198895e18d`. Historical reports stayed immutable. [Accepted plan](../corrected-review-qa-preparation/plan.md) · [Prepared manifest](../corrected-review-qa-preparation/literal-manifest.json) · [Admitted candidate](../corrected-review-qa-preparation/admission-ca9ac7bd.json)
- Verified the entire prior 993 output set, 1,227 files across 13 trees, before overwriting. The current closure recorded 1,680 tracked non-QA source or build files and installed dependency inputs. Fresh Node 22.23.4 `pnpm.cmd build --force` finished all 12 tasks with zero cache hits, remote caching disabled, in 16.323 s. Build log SHA-256 `22987975260d3490639116380fda4405addf757de606c45e0109cca6805d0da8`. [Prior output readback](prebuild-artifact-readback.json) · [Source closure](source-closure-before.json) · [Build log](forced-build.log) · [Build receipt](forced-build-exit.json)
- Admitted all 1,227 fresh output files and 19 critical embedded source modules. Index bundle `/app/assets/index-smG5osOh.js` SHA-256 `b1f84d0868cfffe89e25191b289e008fda58a2e8d061ac7c08dce6eac97a4b64`, source map `4c17c3e0fa20d72ca0eb50a5334939a7173df79bc74c5e5a8b02d4b3dec76b25`, compiled API main `e011151e143f07f29181c03f616b6d8e5b7c04e1f136f001b508e9a480c8cc98`. Each disposable file-SQLite gateway verified its own health PID and served the exact bound HTML/CSS/JS. Each isolated Edge context loaded the candidate bundle. Before and after bindings match SHA-256 `d30f0225116d44e8e22c65aeeda5cb3a07dfa3e3589ab7480395ad256eac7874`. [Before binding](binding-before.json) · [After binding](runs/initial-focused/binding-after.json)
- Six first-attempt fixtures recorded 55 checkpoints, 21 browser PUTs, 20 accepted and one intended HTTP 409. Separate seed and independent writer API calls are outside that PUT total. Zero page errors. [Initial exact-source run index](runs/initial-focused/overview.json)

## Passed targeted correction cases

| Case / disposable loop | Observed outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Duplicate ID · `01M7ECWFFGZQP20WVHJA02JGQG` | Public API still admitted ordinary duplicate holders and reported `DUPLICATE_EDGE_ID`. Visible Remove buttons were native-disabled with a shared duplicate reason. With an edge and a node selected, actual Delete and Backspace each refused with that reason and kept the selections. Exact no-write fingerprints covered server graph/token, device copy, history and save state. Unique control removal and its Undo each produced one correct PUT. [Observed](runs/initial-focused/duplicate/observed.json) |
| Conflict reload · `01M7ECWVPPATDE9CNEG6JKMZ0E` | A real browser edit after a separate writer changed e1's ends received stale If-Match 409. Explicit Reload updated the same editor and synced device without transferring old selection. Backspace from the unselected replacement sent no PUT. Reselect removed only the replacement, focused Undo and one Undo restored its exact graph and token without reviving selection. [Observed](runs/initial-focused/reload/observed.json) |
| Hidden Decision · `01M7ECX8H9S246XJW65T9V3HY1` | Control-click opened the node while the edge was selected. Blank route ID removed the edge path and toolbar, kept exact device ownership/manual route and sent no invalid PUT. Fresh Backspace from the explicitly focused selected node executed **delete work**, with one valid conditional PUT and exact removal of the node's incident edges. One Undo restored the blank graph/ownership in IndexedDB without a server write. Loop issues independently removed only the unique hidden edge. [Observed](runs/initial-focused/hidden/observed.json) |
| Script and geometry · `01M7ECXMVYYTED1G5GJZ3YEX6T` | Removal of the selected Script port's declaration kept its stored edge but cleared selection. One Undo restored the Script graph without reviving selection. A fresh selection survived the native route nudge and geometry Undo. Real Remove then removed only the intended edge. Five conditional PUTs. [Observed](runs/initial-focused/script-geometry/observed.json) |
| Control node drag · `01M7ECY4WCKDWCVZC00YH79AYQ` | The real old overlap repeated. The generated click at +3.4 ms and a distinct trusted click on e1 Remove at +6.2 ms both saw D3 `click.drag`; each was prevented without document delivery. Both observed the attached control visibly unavailable with `aria-disabled=true` and gesture `settling`. The first trusted available hit at +26.9 ms reached document uncanceled after the blocker cleared and removed only e1. One debounced conditional PUT contained the exact node move and removal, and separate Undo PUTs restored the edge and then original geometry. [Observed](runs/initial-focused/node-drag/observed.json) |

## Product failure · Reset double-click activates Remove

Fixture `01M7ECYJ05RGA0PF7JACV6JYA5`. A single genuine Reset and its Undo established the live manual and automatic layouts on the same selected e1 and proved geometry-only behavior. Manual Reset was approximately `x 744.830, y 258.683, width 96.328, height 32`. Manual Remove was at `x 849.158, y 258.683`. After Reset the lone Remove was at `x 746.249, y 283.196`, width `146.578`, height `32`. The naturally visible intersection point `(793.704, 286.940)` hit the live Reset button after Undo.

One ordinary native double-click at that point produced the following actual trusted events with the same selected e1. Times are from the first pointerdown.

| Event | Time | Browser click detail | Hit target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| First click | +4.9 ms | 1 | Reset route, e1 |
| Second pointerdown | +14.8 ms | — | Remove connection, e1 |
| Second click | +17.1 ms | 2 | Remove connection, e1 |

Both click events reached document capture. The second button's position changed because the first action removed Reset and recomputed the toolbar layout. No direct DOM dispatch, forced hit, test-controlled layout or injected delay caused the state change. One debounced PUT from manual baseline token `82af9e461472bd15` removed e1 and preserved the other graph records. API response, public GET and IndexedDB matched token `54e62065a1c1f28c`. Undo first restored e1 with an automatic route and token `747795145df6e606`. A second Undo restored its exact original manual route and token `82af9e461472bd15`. The separate unique Remove and Undo control passed. This is a confirmed product concern at this exact head. It establishes the demonstrated Windows Edge sequence, without a physical-device timing bound. [Geometry, input trace, complete graph, tokens and controls](runs/initial-focused/reset-doubleclick/observed.json) · [Exact fixture outcome](runs/initial-focused/reset-doubleclick/run.json)

## Pending work and cleanup

The broader preservation matrix never launched. It remains available in the sealed drivers for the next admitted head, including the full nine-kind canvas create/remove controls, five Decision families, pan/Reset, blank device recovery and repair, coarse Remove, and ordinary protected Chat. Public duplicate Chat admission remains unproven. Guarded ordering and stale render/in-progress route guards are focused test evidence and were outside this native run.

All six browser sessions and compiled gateways exited zero. Terminal checks found no matching fixture PIDs, no fixture listeners, and no lock, reclaim, WAL or SHM residue. Stores and ports 4747/4748 were outside the fixture. Terminal cleanup SHA-256 `c3fff4cc632092486445afb5703287f1019962348815e8d746d2ab363e1dffe8`. The runner's exit 2 records the product reproduction and stopped before preservation work. No fixture-correction slot was spent and the build/native slot was released. [Terminal cleanup](terminal-cleanup.json)

---

Root disposition: I read this complete report and accept the five targeted passes and the Reset double-click reproduction. Reset becoming Remove under the same pointer is a FIX-IN-PR blocker. The broader preservation matrix has not run. Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh is preparing the bounded UI correction under GPT architecture ownership. This behavior QA used no extra formal scan; the PR remains at 1 of 3. Exact source, original failures and zero-fixture-correction budget are retained. The separate pre-existing Decision/shared-ID routing ambiguity is parked in #481; it is not fixed or newly dispatched here.

Report SHA-256: `6b2a4434eb388a0feb4172166082c43bd9425daaadc1539df6a72117d2b41ec3`. The corrected candidate `ca9ac7bd` is locally frozen and integrates actual main `41bde22c`; the published PR head has not yet advanced to it. No merge approval or owner acceptance is claimed.
